mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks from -38.7 to -31.9, establishing positive momentum that continues into the next four weeks as reopening behavior persists.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -38.7 at t-3w to -31.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite the three-week upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in WORKPLACES to -29.0 signals renewed remote work, which reduces weekday commuter footfall and drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks if the drop persists.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES < -28.0 for two consecutive weekly means.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -23.9 at t-1w to -29.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean even when WORKPLACES stays below -28 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of WORKPLACES below -28 and RESIDENTIAL above 13.5 indicates a stay-at-home shift that cuts discretionary retail trips, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 5.1 points while RESIDENTIAL rose 1.4 points in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean when WORKPLACES < -28 and RESIDENTIAL > 13.5.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT remains stuck near -41, showing that commuter and high-frequency travel has not recovered, which caps retail footfall and sends RETAIL_REC lower over the next week if TRANSIT stays below -40.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT < -40.0 for two consecutive weekly means.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -40.3 at t-1w and -41.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean rises above last 7-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovery above -25 combined with GROCERY_PHARM holding above -10 signals a late-winter thaw and reduced infection fear, which lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 17.4 points over four weeks while GROCERY_PHARM held near -8
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean when PARKS > -25 and GROCERY_PHARM > -10.

mechanism_narrative: In a partial reopening with transit constraints, RETAIL_REC above -35 and TRANSIT above -45 are sufficient for retail to keep climbing as restrictions ease, producing higher RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose while TRANSIT stayed near -41
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean does not exceed last 28-day mean when RETAIL_REC > -35 and TRANSIT > -45.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL at or above 14 for two consecutive weeks means more people are staying home, suppressing errands and leisure trips, which drives RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL > 14.0 for two consecutive weekly means.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 14.1 at t-3w and 14.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean rises above last 7-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above 14.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT below -40 and WORKPLACES below -28 together indicate a stalled reopening, which removes the mobility base for retail and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean when TRANSIT < -40 and WORKPLACES < -28.
